note: Fairly formal; in speech 又 or 再 is common.

examples.zh: 谢谢你再次帮我。
examples.en: Thank you for helping me once again.

examples.zh: 请您再次确认时间。
examples.en: Please confirm the time once more.

examples.zh: 他又病了，昨天再次去了医院。
examples.en: He got sick again and went to the hospital once more yesterday.

note: Often 逃跑 (run away), 逃出 (escape from), 逃课 (skip class).

examples.zh: 他看到警察，马上逃了。
examples.en: He saw the police and ran away at once.

examples.zh: 你想逃到哪儿去？
examples.en: Where do you think you're running off to?

examples.zh: 火很大，大家都逃出了楼。
examples.en: The fire was big, and everyone escaped from the building.

note: In speech, 愿意 is the usual word; 愿 alone appears in set phrases and wishes.

examples.zh: 我愿帮你，不过今天没时间。
examples.en: I'm willing to help you, but I have no time today.

examples.zh: 他不愿回答这个问题。
examples.en: He is not willing to answer this question.

examples.zh: 愿你工作顺利！
examples.en: May your work go smoothly!

meaning: rotten; soft and mushy (well-cooked); (slang) very bad

senses.en: rotten; soft and mushy (well-cooked); (slang) very bad

examples.zh: 这个苹果烂了，别吃了。
examples.en: This apple has gone bad; don't eat it.

examples.zh: 肉做得很烂，孩子也能吃。
examples.en: The meat is cooked very soft, so even the kids can eat it.

examples.zh: 这部电影太烂了，我看不下去。
examples.en: This movie is so bad that I can't sit through it.

examples.zh: 谢谢你邀请我参加婚礼。
examples.en: Thank you for inviting me to the wedding.

examples.zh: 我收到了一个邀请，但是去不了。
examples.en: I got an invitation, but I can't go.

examples.zh: 周末我想邀请朋友来家里吃饭。
examples.en: This weekend I want to invite friends over for a meal.

meaning: although; despite; (as a request) go ahead and

senses.en: although; despite; (as a request) go ahead and

note: 尽管 ... 还是/但是 ... ; also "尽管 + verb" means "feel free to".

examples.zh: 尽管下着雨，他们还是去爬山了。
examples.en: Although it was raining, they still went hiking.

examples.zh: 尽管很累，她还是加班到十点。
examples.en: Tired as she was, she still worked overtime until ten.

examples.zh: 有问题，尽管问我。
examples.en: If you have questions, go ahead and ask me.

meaning: to hide; to dodge; to avoid

senses.en: to hide; to dodge; to avoid

examples.zh: 外面下大雨，我们躲在车里。
examples.en: It was pouring outside, so we sheltered in the car.

examples.zh: 孩子躲在门后面，等我去找他。
examples.en: The child is hiding behind the door, waiting for me to find him.

examples.zh: 你别躲我，我们谈一谈吧。
examples.en: Don't avoid me; let's talk.

meaning: to owe; to be short of

senses.en: to owe; to be short of

examples.zh: 我欠他五百块钱。
examples.en: I owe him five hundred yuan.

examples.zh: 你还欠我一顿饭呢！
examples.en: You still owe me a meal!

examples.zh: 他欠了很多钱，不敢回家。
examples.en: He owes a lot of money and doesn't dare go home.

meaning: to attempt; to try (to do something)

senses.en: to attempt; to try (to do something)

note: Formal; followed by a verb. Often implies the attempt did not succeed.

examples.zh: 他试图解释，但老板不听。
examples.en: He tried to explain, but the boss wouldn't listen.

examples.zh: 她试图说服父母同意。
examples.en: She tried to persuade her parents to agree.

examples.zh: 他试图从窗户进来。
examples.en: He tried to get in through the window.

meaning: to seal; to close off (a road, a place)

senses.en: to seal; to close off (a road, a place)

examples.zh: 因为下雪，高速公路被封了。
examples.en: The expressway was closed because of snow.

examples.zh: 请把信封好再寄。
examples.en: Please seal the letter before you mail it.

examples.zh: 雪太大，这条路封了三天。
examples.en: The snow was so heavy that this road was closed for three days.

meaning: terrific; fierce; severe (praise or bad degree)

senses.en: terrific; fierce; severe (praise or bad degree)

note: Neutral tone lìhai. Praise: "你真厉害"; after 得: "疼得厉害" = hurts badly.

examples.zh: 你今天的汉语说得真厉害！
examples.en: Your Chinese today is really impressive!

examples.zh: 他头疼得厉害，想去看医生。
examples.en: His headache is terrible, and he wants to see a doctor.

examples.zh: 我们老师很厉害，作业一定要交。
examples.en: Our teacher is strict; homework must be handed in.

examples.zh: 阳光从窗户射进来。
examples.en: Sunlight shines in through the window.

examples.zh: 他把球射进了门。
examples.en: He shot the ball into the goal.

examples.zh: 那个灯的光射在我脸上。
examples.en: The light from that lamp is shining on my face.

examples.zh: 他喝醉了，不能开车。
examples.en: He is drunk and can't drive.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上他喝醉了，是朋友送他回家的。
examples.en: He got drunk last night; a friend took him home.

examples.zh: 你醉了吗？我叫出租车送你。
examples.en: Are you drunk? I'll call a taxi to take you home.

examples.zh: 对不起，这是私人问题，我不想回答。
examples.en: Sorry, this is a personal question and I'd rather not answer.

examples.zh: 这是私人电话，请不要用。
examples.en: This is a private phone; please don't use it.

examples.zh: 他开了一家私人医院。
examples.en: He opened a private hospital.

examples.zh: 垃圾好臭，快拿出去。
examples.en: The trash stinks; take it out quickly.

examples.zh: 这双鞋太臭了！
examples.en: These shoes smell awful!

examples.zh: 冰箱里有什么东西臭了？
examples.en: Is something in the fridge stinking?

examples.zh: 电影里的子弹像雨一样飞过来。
examples.en: In the movie, bullets fly like rain.

examples.zh: 警察找到了三颗子弹。
examples.en: The police found three bullets.

examples.zh: 他的腿里还有一颗子弹。
examples.en: There is still a bullet in his leg.

note: 签名 / 签字 = sign; 签合同 = sign a contract.

examples.zh: 请在这里签你的名字。
examples.en: Please sign your name here.

examples.zh: 我明天去签合同。
examples.en: I'm going to sign the contract tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我在文件上签了名。
examples.en: I signed the document.

meaning: measure word for small round things (candies, teeth, stars)

senses.en: measure word for small round things (candies, teeth, stars)

examples.zh: 我吃了三颗糖。
examples.en: I ate three pieces of candy.

examples.zh: 我的一颗牙疼得厉害。
examples.en: One of my teeth hurts badly.

examples.zh: 今天晚上天上有很多颗星星。
examples.en: There are lots of stars in the sky tonight.

examples.zh: 我只不过说了一句，他就生气了。
examples.en: I only said one sentence, and he got angry.

examples.zh: 这只不过是一点儿小事，别担心。
examples.en: It's just a small matter; don't worry.

examples.zh: 他看起来很严肃，只不过心很好。
examples.en: He looks stern; it's just that he has a kind heart.

examples.zh: 我脑子很乱，想不出办法。
examples.en: My mind is a mess; I can't think of a solution.

examples.zh: 他很聪明，脑子转得快。
examples.en: He is smart and thinks fast.

examples.zh: 你动动脑子，再想一想。
examples.en: Use your head and think again.
